items.claim: A pool's `members` are written inside the pool cell, though the diagram ignores them, and they take a node away from its lane
A cluster naming a container is written with the container nested in its group, which the diagram ignores and the reader then drops
A row's `tracking`, and a numeric `weight` that is not bold, are dropped on write with no warning, and rows that differ only in them do not warn
Every container and pool is written dashed, though the diagram draws regions solid
Dash lengths are read and written as absolute, but a draw app scales `dashPattern` by the stroke width
An HTML label's table rows, list containers, `<pre>` and other block elements run together on one line
A vertex's `rotation`, `flipH` and `flipV` are dropped without a warning
A swimlane holding the `container` role mark reads back as a lane when its parent is a pool
`bar` marker written as the draw app's slanted `dash`
`absoluteArcSize=1` ignored when reading a rounded box
unknown shape with `rounded=1` read with no warning
container holding one tall container reads back as a pool
cluster whose members sit in an earlier cluster is nested inside it
`avoid` router written as orthogonal with no warning
HTML label keeps literal newlines and runs of spaces
dragged label on a self-loop with no bends loses its offset
draw-style XML claims only `.xml`, so `.drawio` files can't be picked
writer's font ignores `weight`, header rows, and rows after the first
`UserObject` `placeholders="1"` labels read unsubstituted
empty pool reads back as a plain container
items.note: duplicate of "container holding one tall container" (08b76e0351; the new `weaselRole` style key covers both)

items.claim: `absoluteArcSize` ignored
HTML newlines and spaces kept
self-loop label offset lost
Lane `fillColor=none` drops themed lane fills
items.note: `regionData` in `packages/diagram/src/containers/regionSpecs.ts` draws a lane with no fill, so `none` writes what the diagram shows. A related real defect is listed under extra defects below.

items.claim: Cluster `label` dropped on write
A container's `lanes` lose their members from the file
`arrow-concave` written as `classic` reads back as `arrow`
items.note: Question: this needed a behavior call. An end whose style names no arrowhead now reads as unset (the diagram's own marker), not as draw.io's default `classic`. Recorded in `docs/unruled.md`.

items.claim: Two end labels at one end, one dropped silently
Group holding only containers dropped silently, and edges to it get the wrong warning
Dropped cells still claim ids across pages
Relative vertex geometry under a vertex read as pixels
Edge label `offset` point ignored
items.note: The label is placed on a straight line through the edge's ends and bends, since the read can't know the routed path.

items.claim: Triangle and trapezoid `direction` ignored
items.note: Such a shape still reads as its outline, now with a warning. This covers every known shape that a turn changes, not only triangle and trapezoid.

items.claim: `segmentEdgeStyle` reads as straight
items.note: The side-to-side and top-to-bottom edge styles are fixed too.

items.claim: Multi-line edge and region labels lose their breaks
Swimlane with no `startSize` measured as having no header
Fallback cell id can equal a real id
Containers and pools filled only in their header in draw.io
